question: Rerun executable pretrained/physical workflows and compare with measured public targets and published model references.
provider: Approved installed local backends under explicit prior fresh-run/local authorization. Current Boltzmann contract inspected; no remote resubmission or service charges.

config_order.purpose: Prior RN.Ai convention; explicit site/context audit added.
Input-length ablation: zero-pad guide tokens 20/21 rather than retaining source overhang tokens.
Alternate independent efficacy endpoint; never averaged with RN.Ai/OligoFormer.
Fresh native paired OligoFormer forward inference; no cached efficacy scores in final comparisons.

selection_protocol.primary_efficacy_metric: ROC AUC at observed label >=0.7; native endpoints kept separate
selection_protocol.selection: For each of three eligible target genes, choose among each prefix of frozen configs using mean AUC on the OTHER TWO genes; report selected config AUC on that gene. No ensemble or refit.
selection_protocol.exposure_warning: All these historical cohorts were examined previously. Retrospective leave-one-target-out is NOT an untouched prospective holdout.
selection_protocol.bootstrap: 1000 paired class-stratified row resamples for exploratory AUC/delta intervals; shared/overlapping sites violate row independence; no superiority claim. Small class counts <5 suppress intervals.
selection_protocol.TTR: Two fixed known drug-core anchors ranked among all 598 windows. No config is selected to optimize their rank. Clinical outcomes never treated as sequence labels.
selection_protocol.HTT: Thermodynamic dangle/noLP and missing-context sensitivity only. No new allele/CNS design or config promotion.

execution_details.RN.Ai_Predict: Fresh C00/C01 on all 322 measured pairs and TTR 598 windows; identical TTR input projections explicitly reuse one identical vector.
execution_details.RNAiSpline: Fresh on 322 measured pairs and 598 TTR windows.
execution_details.OligoFormer: Fresh native -i2 paired inference on all 322 measured guides across six transcripts and all 598 TTR windows. Historical cache retained only as a named intermediate reference, excluded from final efficacy vectors.
execution_details.native_OligoFormer_limitation: Upstream CLI leaves training/dropout mode active. Fixed seed 42 and ascending coordinate order frozen; subset/order effects are not a model improvement. Native pos column is an input ordinal, not a transcript coordinate.
execution_details.HTT: Four fresh RNAduplex configurations and three fresh degraded-context RN.Ai controls; not allele/CNS design validation.
execution_details.immune: Fresh unchanged motif scan, curated outcomes, pathogen-target exclusion; descriptive only.
execution_details.blocked_new_models: SiaRNA/ENsiRNA/BERT readiness remains blocked as documented in Run-5; no synthetic features or fallback training.
